quests.instruction: Select the antonym for the given word.
quests.hint: Think about a word meaning to remove offensive capability from.
quests.explanation: Arm means prepare oneself for a military confrontation — the reverse idea is remove offensive capability from, which is what disarm means.

quests.instruction: Find the word with the opposite meaning.
quests.hint: Picture something described as contrary to rule or accepted order or general practice.
quests.explanation: Regular means in accordance with fixed order or procedure or principle; irregular means contrary to rule or accepted order or general practice.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that means the opposite.
quests.hint: Think about a word meaning violating principles of justice.
quests.explanation: While just means used especially of what is legally or ethically right or proper or fitting, unjust means the opposite: violating principles of justice.

quests.instruction: Which option contrasts most directly with the given word?
quests.hint: Consider a word that means not common or ordinarily encountered.
quests.explanation: Common means having no special distinction or quality; uncommon means not common or ordinarily encountered.

quests.instruction: Select the best antonym for the word shown.
quests.hint: Search for a word that captures the idea of being not important.
quests.explanation: Important refers to of great significance or value. Unimportant, by contrast, means not important.

quests.instruction: Find the word that expresses the reverse idea.
quests.hint: Look for a word meaning deliberately violating accepted principles of right and wrong.
quests.explanation: While moral means concerned with principles of right and wrong or conforming to standards of behavior and character based on those principles, immoral means the opposite: deliberately violating accepted principles of right and wrong.

quests.instruction: Choose the option that means the opposite of the given word.
quests.hint: Think about a word meaning not yet brought into existence.
quests.explanation: While born means brought into existence, unborn means the opposite: not yet brought into existence.

quests.instruction: Which word below is the true opposite?
quests.hint: Try to recall a word that means not engaged in a gainful occupation.
quests.explanation: Employed means having your services engaged for — the reverse idea is not engaged in a gainful occupation, which is what unemployed means.

quests.instruction: Pick the word that contrasts with the meaning shown.
quests.hint: Try to recall a word that means having no limits in range or scope.
quests.explanation: Limited describes small in range or scope, while unlimited describes having no limits in range or scope.

quests.instruction: Identify the antonym among the options.
quests.hint: Consider a word that means not acceptable.
quests.explanation: Acceptable means worthy of acceptance or satisfactory — the reverse idea is not acceptable, which is what unacceptable means.

quests.instruction: Select the antonym for the given word.
quests.hint: Try to recall a word that means not yet mature.
quests.explanation: To be mature is to be having reached full natural growth or development. Immature means not yet mature, the reverse quality.

quests.instruction: Find the word with the opposite meaning.
quests.hint: The opposite idea here relates to being not in good physical or mental condition.
quests.explanation: Fit means physically and mentally sound or healthy — the reverse idea is not in good physical or mental condition, which is what unfit means.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that means the opposite.
quests.hint: The opposite idea here relates to being not having come in contact.
quests.explanation: Touched means having come into contact, so its opposite, untouched, means not having come in contact.

quests.instruction: Which option contrasts most directly with the given word?
quests.hint: The opposite idea here relates to being not true to duty or obligation or promises.
quests.explanation: Faithful means steadfast in affection or allegiance; unfaithful means not true to duty or obligation or promises.

quests.instruction: Select the best antonym for the word shown.
quests.hint: This word describes something that is not available or accessible or at hand.
quests.explanation: Available means obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service; unavailable means not available or accessible or at hand.

quests.instruction: Find the word that expresses the reverse idea.
quests.hint: Search for a word that captures the idea of being devoid of importance, meaning, or force.
quests.explanation: Significant means important in effect or meaning, so its opposite, insignificant, means devoid of importance, meaning, or force.

quests.instruction: Choose the option that means the opposite of the given word.
quests.hint: Consider a word that means not in or exhibiting good health in body or mind.
quests.explanation: To be healthy is to be having or indicating good health in body or mind. Unhealthy means not in or exhibiting good health in body or mind, the reverse quality.

quests.instruction: Which word below is the true opposite?
quests.hint: Think about a word meaning to refuse to go along with.
quests.explanation: While obey means be obedient to, disobey means the opposite: refuse to go along with.

quests.instruction: Pick the word that contrasts with the meaning shown.
quests.hint: This word describes something that is lacking in value or merit.
quests.explanation: Worthy means having worth or merit or value; unworthy means lacking in value or merit.

quests.instruction: Identify the antonym among the options.
quests.hint: This word means to make disconnected, disjoin or unfasten.
quests.explanation: To connect means to connect, fasten, or put together two or more pieces. To disconnect means the opposite: to make disconnected, disjoin or unfasten.

quests.instruction: Select the antonym for the given word.
quests.hint: Imagine describing something as impossible to hear.
quests.explanation: Audible means heard or perceptible by the ear, so its opposite, inaudible, means impossible to hear.

quests.instruction: Find the word with the opposite meaning.
quests.hint: Picture something described as lacking kindness.
quests.explanation: Kind means having or showing a tender and considerate and helpful nature — the reverse idea is lacking kindness, which is what unkind means.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that means the opposite.
quests.hint: Search for a word that means the speech act of disagreeing or arguing or disputing.
quests.explanation: Agreement means the verbal act of agreeing; disagreement means the speech act of disagreeing or arguing or disputing.

quests.instruction: Which option contrasts most directly with the given word?
quests.hint: Search for a word that captures the idea of in an unnecessary manner.
quests.explanation: Necessarily means in an essential manner — the reverse idea is in an unnecessary manner, which is what unnecessarily means.

quests.instruction: Select the best antonym for the word shown.
quests.hint: This word refers to the state of being tense and feeling pain.
quests.explanation: Comfort means a state of being relaxed and feeling no pain; discomfort means the state of being tense and feeling pain.

quests.instruction: Find the word that expresses the reverse idea.
quests.hint: Search for a word that means the state of being unemployed or not having a job.
quests.explanation: Employment refers to the state of being employed or having a job, while unemployment refers to the state of being unemployed or not having a job.

quests.instruction: Choose the option that means the opposite of the given word.
quests.hint: This word describes something that is not suited to your comfort, purpose or needs.
quests.explanation: Convenient means suited to your comfort or purpose or needs; inconvenient means not suited to your comfort, purpose or needs.

quests.instruction: Which word below is the true opposite?
quests.hint: Search for a word that means the quality of having an inferior or less favorable position.
quests.explanation: Advantage means the quality of having a superior or more favorable position — the reverse idea is the quality of having an inferior or less favorable position, which is what disadvantage means.

quests.instruction: Pick the word that contrasts with the meaning shown.
quests.hint: Imagine describing something as not disposed or inclined toward.
quests.explanation: While willing means disposed or inclined toward, unwilling means the opposite: not disposed or inclined toward.

quests.instruction: Identify the antonym among the options.
quests.hint: Look for a word meaning not capable of being foretold.
quests.explanation: Predictable means capable of being foretold, so its opposite, unpredictable, means not capable of being foretold.
